title: Restore reliable flying-hearts LoveTransitionOverlay animation on Yes click

requirements.summary: Make the “Yes! 💕” click reliably show the LoveTransitionOverlay with visible animated hearts/emojis/balloons for ~3 seconds, then return to the accepted content, consistently across repeated runs.
acceptanceCriteria: On the final slide, clicking “Yes! 💕” renders the LoveTransitionOverlay for ~3 seconds and then returns to the accepted state content.
During the overlay, heart elements are clearly visible (not zero-size) and animate upward (not static).
The overlay animation works consistently across multiple consecutive clicks on “Yes! 💕” (no intermittent failures due to randomization/state).

file_operations.description: Ensure the overlay can be re-triggered deterministically by introducing a transition run id/counter and rendering LoveTransitionOverlay with a unique React key per run, while keeping the existing single-page flow (overlay then accepted state).

Stabilize overlay particle generation for the duration of a run (e.g., generate random positions/sizes once per mount/run id rather than on every render) so the 3-second animation is consistent and doesn’t intermittently fail.

requirements.summary: Prevent invalid CSS transforms caused by undefined CSS variables so the browser does not drop the floating animations.
acceptanceCriteria: The love-emoji, balloon, and heart keyframe animations no longer rely on an undefined CSS variable value that can invalidate the transform property.
DevTools shows the animated elements have active animations (not crossed out) and their computed transform values are valid throughout the animation.

file_operations.description: Update the love-emoji-float, balloon-float, and love-heart-float keyframes to use safe CSS variable fallbacks (e.g., var(--random, <fallback>)) anywhere var(--random) is referenced so computed transforms remain valid even if a custom property is missing.

Set required CSS custom properties per animated element (e.g., assign a per-element --random value via inline style) so translateX calc() expressions resolve to valid transforms and animations are not dropped.

requirements.summary: Render flying lucide Heart icons at intended random sizes using SVG-appropriate sizing (width/height or component props) instead of fontSize.
acceptanceCriteria: The flying Heart icons in the transition overlay render at varied, visibly different sizes.
No console warnings/errors occur during the overlay animation related to invalid styles/attributes for the Heart SVG.

file_operations.description: Replace Heart icon sizing that currently uses fontSize with SVG-appropriate sizing (e.g., Heart 'size' prop or explicit width/height), preserving random size variation for each heart and avoiding invalid SVG style usage.
